root.name: プロスペリティ・バンクシェアーズ

relations.text: 合併したローンスター銀行の融資を引き継ぐ
relations.text_en: Prosperity Bank took over its Lone Star loan by merger

source.label: AST SpaceMobile 10-Q(2026年9月期)
source.quote: Prosperity Capital Equipment Loan On August 14, 2023, AST LLC and certain other subsidiaries of the Company entered into a loan agreement with Lone Star State Bank of West Texas ("Lone Star"), succeeded by Prosperity Bank by merger with Lone Star, providing for a $15.0 million principal term loan secured by certain real property fixtures and equipment in one of the Company's Texas facilities (the "Lone Star Loan Agreement").

companies.name: レガシー・ハウジング

relations.text_en: Prosperity Bank is administrative agent on its revolver

source.label: Legacy Housing 10-Q(2026年9月期)
source.quote: LINES OF CREDIT The Company has a Credit Agreement (the "Revolver"), by and among the Company as borrower, the financial institutions from time to time party thereto, as lenders, and Prosperity Bank as administrative agent.

relations.text_en: Provides a warehouse line of credit to its mortgage unit

source.label: Linkhome Holdings 10-Q(2026年9月期)
source.quote: On October 28, 2026, Prosperity Bank suspended the funding of new advances under its $10,000,000 warehouse line of credit with Mortgage One pending its review of the change in ownership of Mortgage One.
